EMA invited industry to propose topics for discussion, of which ten were selected for discussion, see the agenda below. Most short talks were given by members of the [EFSPI statistical methodology leaders group](https://efspieurope.github.io/eml/methods_members.html).

- [Agenda](agenda.pdf).
